results.title: forming en route
results.overview: At various paces and rhythms, a portrait of a French estuary town unfolds - a study of how light falls on a locale and its various aspects. As we wander from place to place through reflections and shadows, intermittently entering into different worlds, we notice how the activities of the inhabitants shape our experience of the environment. The people, architecture, weather, the everyday details, given equal significance in forming the landscape of the film with a dreamlike inner logic.

results.title: Stars Above Us
results.overview: A man reflects on his teenage years and the deep bond he had with a friend who, despite being bullied and struggling with severe depression, seemed untouchable in his eyes. As he looks back on their time together, he grapples with her tragic death and the haunting memories of the girl he thought was the coolest person in the world.

results.title: Paseo al Parque
results.overview: A walk through the Parc des Buttes-Chaumont. As sunlight bathes the trees and the bodies of those strolling through the park, a low-resolution cellphone camera struggles to process the light.

results.title: MGP: The Untamed Circuit
results.overview: This film centers on the 2025 Macau Grand Prix, telling the story of world-famous racers competing on the Guia Circuit. It also weaves together the history of the 72 editions of the event, showing the changes and constants of the Macau Grand Prix, and highlighting the development achievements of China’s automotive industry and motorsport events.

results.title: Performance of the Year
results.overview: Olivia, a struggling actor, is forced into the biggest audition of her career with the last director she'd ever work for. Her whole life is turned upside down when she is pushed to her limits for this pretentious director's masterpiece.

results.title: The Date
results.overview: Jazmín is excited: this afternoon she will have her first date in years. Filled with a nervous energy, she wonders what the day will bring – but as the minutes roll by, things do not turn out the way she had hoped…

results.title: Infection
results.overview: An ambitious office worker suspects her boss’s mysterious illness may be contagious. With a promotion within reach, she faces a choice between professional advancement and the person she wants to remain.

results.title: Advisor 101
results.overview: Short film companion to 4EVE's music video ที่ปรึกษา

results.title: Carrascal
results.overview: The film tells the story of women in rural Brazil who, over the course of three generations (1970–2025), respond to violence and exclusion through strategies of cooperation and a sense of solidarity.

results.title: Kronoshock
results.overview: Nestled in the middle of a secluded valley and surrounded by green meadows and rivers, an imposing mass of snow and rock rises abruptly. The adventurous Lord Cliffrider hopes to be the first to achieve the summit of his longed-for mountain, but as time passes, this dream vanishes like the smoke from his pipe. This is a silent stop-motion film about the ambitions of a climber to reach the top.

results.title: Just How Things Are
results.overview: Clement just lost the love of his life. Failing to reconnect with his sister, Nelle,  he learns that he must take drastic measures to ensure the possibility of ever reclaiming the ideal life he once had.

results.title: Starting Towards the Finish Line
results.overview: Unable to reach Lianhua Town, Xiaoqing stumbles upon the frame of a car buried under silt four years ago. Then a wild idea strikes him: restore the car and drive there. Meanwhile, Dapang, eager for a tasty treat, and Gezi, who needs to deliver a letter for his grandma, also need to head to Lianhua Town. They strike an agreement with Xiaoqing. Zhang Zhigao, a volunteer teacher concerned about the children’s education, joins the team to rebuild the car. And so begins this pursuit of a dream. United by the resolve to set off, they embark on an extraordinary journey.

results.title: Steadfast Woman
results.overview: This film centers on the ups and downs of an ordinary woman, Chunxia, chronicling her journey of growth — swept along by fate and healing herself amid suffering.

results.title: The Perfect
results.overview: High-achieving teenager Pärli feels like a mountain range: cold below the knees and hot in her hands. She compares parts of her body to different seasons and playfully envies a dancing grasshopper's movements. If not a ballerina, she imagines being a violinist or lion tamer. Aspiring Black Swan Maarja took up ballet at her parents' urging, though she preferred hip-hop. Ballet lecturer and horse rider Irina teaches students to appreciate the technically perfect ballet body, yet struggles to find joy and tends to censor everything, even as she resists strict control. All three strive for perfection in life and on the dance floor. Ballet offers escape into a magical world but demands patience. Dancers repeat exercises and rehearse for hours, seeking precision despite pain, fatigue or waning motivation. Each movement takes time to master, perhaps only to satisfy a mother's high expectations.

results.title: Fruitcakes: Dawn of Drag
results.overview: Jolanda, a retired archivist, has spent most of his life in the closet. In the late 1970s, he stood on stage alongside his friend Mummo in Finland's first drag show, 'Happy Gays'; the performance was even broadcast on television, and Mummo became one of the first openly gay men in Finland. Then came AIDS, fear and violence. In April 1988, Mummo was murdered in his home; the police were unwilling to solve the case and the entire crime was hushed up. Now, more than thirty years later, Jolanda is opening up his own archive and inviting a new generation of drag artists to bring 'Happy Gays' back to the stage.

results.title: Tiliche
results.overview: A Tiliche dancer from Oaxaca loses his colorful fabrics in an attempt to assimilate into the unfamiliar, gray world that surrounds him.
